class.name: SpinePathConstraintData
class.brief_description: Stores the setup pose for a path constraint.
class.description: Stores the setup pose for a path constraint. A path constraint adjusts constrained bones so they follow a path attachment on a slot. Runtime mix values live on [code]SpinePathConstraintPose[/code]. Read the default values with [code]get_setup_pose()[/code]. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-path-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this path constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_offset_rotation
method.description: An offset added to the constrained bone rotation.

method.name: get_position_mode
method.description: The mode for positioning the first bone on the path.

method.name: get_rotate_mode
method.description: The mode for adjusting the rotation of the bones.

method.name: get_setup_pose
method.description: Returns the setup pose for this path constraint data.

method.name: get_slot
method.description: The slot whose path attachment drives this constraint.

method.name: get_spacing_mode
method.description: The mode for positioning the bones after the first bone on the path.

method.name: set_offset_rotation
method.description: Sets the offset added to constrained bone rotation.

method.name: set_position_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for positioning the first bone on the path.

method.name: set_rotate_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for adjusting constrained bone rotation.

method.name: set_slot
method.description: Sets the slot data whose path attachment drives this constraint.

method.name: set_spacing_mode
method.description: Sets the mode for positioning bones after the first bone on the path.
